notes: Rowena Rig (r7, cut from hima-base; Mage face, body, shading and motion untouched): centre-parted fringe with a widening forehead V, side locks that fall straight with vertical strand lines and square off at the hem, and an enlarged 11x8 pink E/D/F collar bow with a knot and two tails. Per tier the base's own motion carries over - sleep: lids shut + zzZ; bored: blink, crown strand slip, lock tips sway out 1 px; cruise: left lock shears left 1-3, smile, hem sway; fast: left lock streams as notched strands, right lock pressed, grin, speed lines; top: sparkle eyes, shout, max stream + stars. No baked bob; feet fixed on the last rows.
